overview: The Community Preservation Committee reviewed presentations for five Community Preservation Act funding applications, including historical preservation, affordable housing, and recreation projects. No funding decisions were made, as committee deliberations were set for subsequent meetings.

items.title: Condon Shell Renovations
items.summary: Allie Fiske presented an application from the Mayor's Office seeking $80,265 in CPA funding to clean, seal masonry leaks, apply weatherproofing, and repair exterior lighting at the Condon Shell.

items.title: St. Clement and St. Francis Affordable Housing Development
items.summary: Danny LeBlanc of the Somerville Community Corporation presented a $600,000 CPA request to adaptively reuse former church parish buildings to create 29 permanently affordable housing units.

items.title: LaPrise Village Heating Conversion
items.summary: Medford Housing Authority Executive Director Jeffrey Driscoll presented a $452,000 CPA application to convert 138 heating units at LaPrise Village from oil to natural gas to alleviate safety concerns and financial hardship for residents.

items.title: Medford Historical Society Museum HVAC Improvements
items.summary: John Anderson presented a CPA proposal on behalf of the Medford Historical Society and Museum to replace outdated air conditioning and convert the museum's heating system from oil to natural gas.

items.title: Medford Historical Society Textile Preservation
items.summary: Heather Shampney Anderson and Beth Hayes requested CPA funding to professionally clean, repair, and properly store 35 historic textile items from the museum's collection.
